references.text: Micah 3:12 describes how Jerusalem will become a ruin, which reflects the warning Jesus gives in Matthew 23:38 that the house (the temple) will be left desolate.
Jeremiah 22:5 warns that if obedience is not followed, the house (in this context the king's house, but it can also be interpreted more broadly as God's house) will be abandoned.
Deuteronomy 28:62 speaks of how Israel will be left and destroyed due to disobedience to God's commands, which can be seen as a parallel to the warning in Matthew 23:38.
